Club Football Estrela Amadora SAD, sometimes just Estrela Amadora, is a Portuguese professional sports club based in Amadora, northwest of Lisbon. The team is currently competing in the Primeira Liga, the top tier of Portuguese football, after winning promotion from Liga Portugal 2 in 2022–23.
